cause: The scenario's pre-exchange snapshot queried SaleInvoice with seed.count(... createdShiftId=?); SaleInvoice uses shiftId. Sale and partial return completed in temporary SQLite, then the test-only snapshot failed before attempting exchange.
financialAndStockState: The harness event checkpoints through partial return reconciled report/raw financials, blue reference, and stock ledger. No real DB or production code was modified.
resolution: Changed only the scenario harness snapshot query to count SaleInvoice by shiftId; reran the full scenario in a fresh temporary SQLite database.
